title: Status Verdicts
prompt: Implement classify(status: int) -> str returning exactly one of: 'ok' (2xx), 'redirect' (3xx), 'client_error' (4xx), 'server_error' (5xx), 'invalid' (anything else, including < 100 or > 599).

tests.name: families map correctly
tests.code:
assert classify(200) == 'ok'
assert classify(201) == 'ok'
assert classify(301) == 'redirect'
assert classify(404) == 'client_error'
assert classify(503) == 'server_error'

tests.name: out-of-range is invalid
tests.hint: HTTP status codes live between 100 and 599.
